meta.library_note: 32 electrical and instrumentation installation modules authored by VissRad. Demonstration norms, not market or benchmark data: calibrate to your own history before a plan is issued.

materials.desc: Ground rod, 3/4 in x 10 ft, with test well
Rigid galvanized conduit, 1 in average, with fittings
Ladder cable tray, 24 in aluminum, with fittings
Instrument cable, single pair shielded, armored
Stainless tubing, 1/2 in, with compression fittings

modules.name: E&I mobilization and cable yard
modules.desc: E&I mobilization inside an operating or new-build plant: tool and material cribs, the cable reel yard and reel tracking, temporary power and the E&I work-permit and safety orientation.

queries.prompt: Cable reels to receive and track

tasks.desc: E&I execution plan, permits and orientation
Cable reel yard, receive and tag {REELS} reels
E&I ready for first work face

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Grounding grid and equipment bonding
modules.desc: Below-grade grounding grid and ground rods, exothermic connections, risers, then above-grade bonding of steel, vessels, tanks, motors and equipment, with fall-of-potential testing.

tasks.desc: Trench and lay grid conductor ({LF} ft)
Drive {RODS} ground rods and test wells

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Underground duct banks and conduit
modules.desc: Red-concrete duct banks and direct-buried conduit from the substation to the units: trench, lay conduit, encase, manholes and pull boxes, mandrel and pull strings.

tasks.desc: Encase in red concrete and backfill
Mandrel, pull strings and as-built survey

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Cable tray and supports
modules.desc: Main cable tray on the pipe rack and in the units: supports and stanchions, ladder tray and fittings, covers where required, bonding jumpers and tray identification.

tasks.desc: Install ladder tray and fittings ({LF} ft)
Tray walkdown and release for cable

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Above-ground conduit
modules.desc: Rigid conduit from the tray to motors, instruments, lighting and junction boxes: bending, supports, seals in hazardous areas and pull strings.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Substation, E-house and MV switchgear
modules.desc: Set the prefabricated E-house or substation building on its foundation, set MV switchgear line-ups, bus duct and splice shipping splits, then internal wiring between shipping sections.

tasks.desc: Receive and inspect E-house and gear

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Power transformers
modules.desc: Set substation and unit transformers, dress radiators and bushings, oil fill and processing on liquid-filled units, and the transformer grounding and neutral connections.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: MCCs, LV switchgear and VFDs
modules.desc: Set low-voltage switchgear, motor control centers and drives, rejoin shipping sections, install the internal bus splices and control wiring between sections.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: UPS and DC systems
modules.desc: Plant UPS for the control system and the DC battery systems for switchgear control: set cabinets and racks, install and connect batteries, initial charge with the vendor.

tasks.desc: Set UPS cabinets and battery racks

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: MV cable pulls
modules.desc: Medium-voltage feeders from the substation to unit transformers and large motors: pull planning and tension calculations, reel setups, pulls through duct bank and tray, and cable dressing.

tasks.desc: Dress, tag and secure in tray

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: LV power and control cable
modules.desc: Low-voltage power to motors, heaters, lighting panels and welding outlets, and control cable for motor control and interlocks: pull, dress and tag.

tasks.desc: Dress, tag and cable schedule mark-up

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Instrument cable and home runs
modules.desc: Single-pair instrument cable from each field device to its junction box, and the multipair home runs from junction boxes to the rack room or remote I/O.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Fiber optic and plant network
modules.desc: Armored fiber between the control room, rack rooms, substations and remote I/O: pull, splice, terminate in patch panels and OTDR test each strand.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: MV terminations and splices
modules.desc: Stress-cone terminations at switchgear, transformers and motors, and in-line splices in manholes, by qualified MV splicers, ready for VLF testing.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: LV and instrument terminations
modules.desc: Glanding and termination of LV power, control and instrument cables at motors, MCC buckets, junction boxes, marshalling and I/O cabinets, with ferrules and wire tags to the connection diagrams.

queries.prompt: Cable ends to gland and terminate

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Motor connections, solo runs and rotation
modules.desc: Connect motors, insulation resistance test the windings, bump for rotation uncoupled, then solo run with the mechanical crew before coupling.

tasks.desc: Winding IR and polarization index tests
Solo run and record currents and vibration

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Lighting, receptacles and welding outlets
modules.desc: Area and platform lighting, lighting panels and contactors, convenience receptacles and welding outlets, then photometric and circuit checks.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Electric heat tracing
modules.desc: Self-regulating heat trace on process lines and instrument tubing: pre-insulation IR test, install with power connection kits and end seals, post-insulation IR test and controller set-up.

tasks.desc: Power kits, end seals and junctions ({CKTS} circuits)
Post-insulation IR test and controller set-up

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Cathodic protection
modules.desc: Galvanic or impressed-current protection for buried piping and tank bottoms: anodes, rectifier, test stations and the native and polarized potential survey.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Field instrument installation
modules.desc: Stands, supports and junction boxes, then mounting of transmitters, switches, gauges, thermowell elements and analyzers as released by piping, protected until commissioning.

tasks.desc: Set and hook up analyzer shelter

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Impulse tubing and instrument air
modules.desc: Stainless impulse tubing and manifolds from process taps to transmitters, and the instrument air headers and drops to valves, then pressure and leak testing.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Control and on / off valve hook-up
modules.desc: Instrument scope on valves set by piping: positioners, solenoids, limit switches, air sets and tubing, wiring to the junction box, then stroke checks.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: DCS, SIS and PLC cabinets
modules.desc: Set system, marshalling and I/O cabinets in the rack room and remote instrument enclosures, power distribution and grounding, network, then power-up with the system vendor.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Cable insulation resistance and continuity
modules.desc: Insulation resistance (megger) and continuity on every installed cable before termination is released, and VLF withstand on MV cable after terminations.

tasks.desc: IR and continuity, LV and instrument ({LV})
Test records to the cable schedule

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Electrical acceptance testing (NETA)
modules.desc: Acceptance testing of switchgear, breakers, protective relays, transformers and MCCs to ANSI/NETA ATS, with relay settings applied and verified.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Instrument calibration
modules.desc: Bench or in-situ calibration of transmitters and switches to the instrument datasheets, HART configuration, with calibration certificates.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Point-to-point wiring checks
modules.desc: Wire-by-wire verification from the field device through junction box and marshalling to the I/O channel, against the loop and connection drawings, before power-up of the loops.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Energization of permanent power
modules.desc: Energization of the substation and the unit distribution from the utility or plant feed, step by step under a switching plan, with lockout / tagout handed over to operations control.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Loop checks
modules.desc: Live loop checks with the control system: signal injection or stroke from the field, verify range, alarms and engineering units at the operator station, and sign the loop folder.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Cause-and-effect and SIS functional testing
modules.desc: Functional tests of interlocks and safety instrumented functions to the cause-and-effect charts: trip each initiator and verify every final element and alarm, witnessed by operations.

tasks.desc: Test procedures from the cause-and-effect charts

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Hazardous-area inspection
modules.desc: Detailed inspection of equipment in classified areas against the hazardous-area classification drawings: equipment ratings, glands, seals, enclosures and bonding.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: E&I mechanical completion by system
modules.desc: System walkdowns, A and B punch lists, completed check sheets and test records collected into the turnover package, then E&I mechanical completion signed system by system.
modules.author: VissRad

worklist.desc: DCS, SIS and remote I/O cabinets
MV feeders and large motor cables
Cable IR, continuity and VLF tests
Switchgear, relay and transformer acceptance tests
Motor connections, solo runs and rotation
